theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  classical
  let f : ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have h_finite : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
    have : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨hB n |>.1, hB (n + 1) |>.1⟩, hB (n + 2) |>.1⟩, hB (n + 3) |>.1⟩,
             ⟨⟨⟨hB n |>.2, hB (n + 1) |>.2⟩, hB (n + 2) |>.2⟩, hB (n + 3) |>.2⟩⟩
    exact Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T))) this
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! h
    have : Function.Injective f := by
      intro i j h'
      by_cases h'' : i = j
      · exact h''
      · have : i < j ∨ j < i := by omega
        cases this with
        | inl h'' => exact (h i j h'' h').elim
        | inr h'' => exact (h j i h'' (by simp [h'])).elim
    exact Set.not_infinite.mpr h_finite (Set.infinite_range_of_injective this)
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, f] at h_eq
  have h₁ : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      match m with
      | 0 => exact h_eq.1
      | 1 => exact h_eq.2.1
      | 2 => exact h_eq.2.2.1
      | 3 => exact h_eq.2.2.2
      | m + 4 =>
        have h₂ := hu (i + (m + 4)) (by omega)
        have h₃ := hu (j + (m + 4)) (by omega)
        have h₄ : (i + (m + 4) - 1 : ℕ) = i + (m + 3) := by omega
        have h₅ : (i + (m + 4) - 2 : ℕ) = i + (m + 2) := by omega
        have h₆ : (i + (m + 4) - 3 : ℕ) = i + (m + 1) := by omega
        have h₇ : (i + (m + 4) - 4 : ℕ) = i + m := by omega
        have h₈ : (j + (m + 4) - 1 : ℕ) = j + (m + 3) := by omega
        have h₉ : (j + (m + 4) - 2 : ℕ) = j + (m + 2) := by omega
        have h₁₀ : (j + (m + 4) - 3 : ℕ) = j + (m + 1) := by omega
        have h₁₁ : (j + (m + 4) - 4 : ℕ) = j + m := by omega
        norm_cast at h₂ h₃ ⊢
        simp_all [h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇, h₈, h₉, h₁₀, h₁₁]
  use i, (j - i)
  constructor
  · omega
  · intro n hn
    have := h₁ (n - i)
    simp [add_sub_cancel' hn, add_sub_assoc, sub_add_cancel (by omega : i ≤ n)] at this ⊢
    exact this
